name: ALPV — Enable Native Push (Profile 1) When I/O Alarm Starts
description: Switches on AXIS License Plate Verifier push profile 1 when digital input 1 becomes active, so ALPV sends plate reads in its own format (UTMC-1, UTMC-2, HTTP POST, TCP or FTP) only during the alarm. Pair with 8.3b. Configure profile 1 in ALPV first and leave it disabled. Replace the username and password with an administrator account on this device. Disabled on import.
